# AppZut - Curated Mobile Library & Mods
> Verified mobile modifications, emulators, and utility packages for iOS and Android.

## Core Hub Pages
- [AppZut Home](https://appzut.com/): Official curated index of tested mobile applications and game modifications.
- [AppZut.com Portal](https://appzut.com/appzut-dot-com.html): High-availability portal for verified community builds.
- [AppZut Com Repository](https://appzut.com/appzut-com.html): Direct application catalog and installation guides.
- [AppZut Space Mirror](https://appzut.com/appzut-dot-space.html): High-speed mirror network for mobile installations.
